title: Uday Singh v. State of U.P. — recovery notice relegated to Para 6.8 objection
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Surya Prakash Kesarwani, J.; Jayant Banerji, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; Para 6.8 objection with eight-week stay of recovery.
headnote: Without deciding merits, the Allahabad High Court disposed of a consumer's challenge to a 11 January 2022 electricity recovery notice by granting liberty to file an objection under Para 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within four weeks, directing time-bound disposal after hearing, and staying coercive recovery for eight weeks or until that disposal, whichever is earlier.
facts: Uday Singh petitioned the Allahabad High Court to quash recovery pursuant to a 11 January 2022 revenue-determination notice (patrank no. 7573/V.V.Kha.-VI/Bulandshahr) issued by the Executive Engineer, Paschimanchal Power Supply Corporation Ltd., Power Supply Division-VI, Bulandshahr, and to restrain further recovery. Counsel for the distribution company stated on instructions that the petitioner could file an objection to the demand, which would be decided in accordance with law within a time-bound period.

holding_units.topic: objection to recovery notice; stay of coercive action
holding_units.holding: Without expressing any opinion on merits, the writ was disposed of with liberty to submit an objection under Para 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 before the assessing officer within four weeks; if so submitted, the objection shall be decided in accordance with law within the next four weeks after reasonable opportunity of hearing, and no coercive action shall be taken on the impugned demand for eight weeks or till disposal of the objection, whichever is earlier.

principle_tags.application: Challenge to a 11.01.2022 recovery notice was disposed by directing a time-bound Para 6.8 objection, with stay of coercive action for eight weeks or till disposal, whichever is earlier.
The Court declined merits review of the recovery notice and relegated the consumer to the statutory objection under Para 6.8.

not_decided.point: Merits of the 11.01.2022 recovery notice and demand
not_decided.note: Disposed without expressing any opinion on merits.
